newsitem.title: USA: Millennium sees ethylene plant delayed.
newsitem.headline: Millennium sees ethylene plant delayed.

text.p: Millennium Chemicals Inc does not expect a planned 910,000-tonne ethylene plant to be built before 2001, even if it can find a partner to replace Eastman Chemical Co, which dropped out of a four-way venture last year, Millennium said on Friday.
The partners initially expected to open the plant in 2000.
"I think the odds are 50-50 that we find a new partner," Millennium Chief Executive Robert Lee told a conference call after the release of the company's first-quarter earnings.
Other partners remaining in the venture are Lyondell Petrochemical Co and Union Carbide Corp.
"They are still in, until we hear from them to the contrary," Lee said.
He said that Millennium needed the new capacity.
"We are ethylene short. We do need that plant," Lee said.
